hypothesis_text: NVFP4-quantized Gemma 4 shows a quantitatively different cooperation lock-in pattern from BF16 Gemma 4 in repeated PD: NVFP4 locks at 1.00, BF16 fluctuates in a 0.85-0.95 band against the same TFT opponent and prompt.
prior_art_summary: Quantization × behavioral-economics interaction in LLMs is largely unstudied. Most quantization work measures perplexity / MMLU; behavioral lock-in as a quantization-sensitive effect is not a published result.
rationale: Cross-cuts quantization research and behavioral game theory in a way the literature has not. Genuinely novel without being implausible.
